title: Security Risks of Unmanaged Virtual Machines
excerpt: Forgotten virtual machines and excessive permissions create IT security blind spots, requiring centralized management and automation.
body_html:
Forgotten virtual machines, unpatched servers, and overly broad access permissions can introduce significant security blind spots within IT environments. Traditional firewalls alone may not adequately address these hidden risks.

To mitigate these vulnerabilities, organizations can utilize centralized infrastructure management. Additionally, implementing strict access controls and resource lifecycle automation helps maintain oversight over digital assets and reduces overall security exposure.
